'NothingFound: invalid-destination (LLM country code)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' LIKE '%invalid-date%' THEN 'NothingFound: invalid-date (год > +365 / в прошлом)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' THEN 'NothingFound: no tickets' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' THEN 'scenario.failed: ' || COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->>'error_type', 'unknown') WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' IS NULL THEN 'HTTP: no response (timeout/conn err)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' = '429' THEN type = 'http.request.sent' THEN LEFT(COALESCE(payload->'response'->>'error', payload->'request'->>'url', ''), 200) ELSE '' END AS "Сообщение / URL", LEFT(COALESCE(data, ''), 200) AS "User query", CASE WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'IndexError' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' = 'list index out of range' THEN 'Resolved (PR #381)' WHEN type = 'Unresolved (LLM год даты)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'TypeError' THEN 'Unresolved (TypeError float/None)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'KeyError' THEN 'Unresolved (KeyError other)' WHEN type = 'scenario.failed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' = 'NothingFoundTravelPayouts' THEN 'Not a bug (no tickets)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' IN ('429', '503') THEN 'External API issue' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' IS NULL THEN 'Unresolved (HTTP timeout)' WHEN type = 'http.request.sent' AND payload->'response'->>'status_code' = '200' THEN 'Unresolved (HTTP 200 marked failed)' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS bucket FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)) SELECT received_at::date AS day, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket LIKE 'Resolved%') AS resolved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket LIKE 'In Review%') AS in_review, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket LIKE 'Unresolved%' OR bucket = 'External API issue' OR bucket = 'Unknown') AS unresolved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bucket LIKE 'Not a bug%') AS not_a_bug FROM classified GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Системные предупреждения (плашки) — распределение по коду
panels.description: Каждое событие `system.warning.shown` логируется параллельно основному сценарию. Поле `data` = стабильный код (см. /opt/analytics-platform/docs/warning-codes.md).

targets.rawSql: SELECT data AS "Код", count(*) AS "Показано" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'system.warning.shown' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY data ORDER BY count(*) DESC;

panels.title: Последние системные предупреждения (с привязкой к запросу)
panels.description: Для каждой плашки видно request_id, чтобы открыть в табличке «Каждая failed-запись» или поднять полный сценарий по этому id.

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS "Время", data AS "Код", request_id, payload->'scenario' AS "Контекст" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type = 'system.warning.shown' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;
